easy.statement_latex:

$$\begin{cases} y = 8 x - 19 \\ 4 x + 3 y = 27 \end{cases}$$

$$\begin{cases} y = 10 x + 1 \\ 9 x + 11 y = 11 \end{cases}$$
hints: The first equation already gives $y$ in terms of $x$. Substitute that expression for $y$ into the second equation.
Replace $y$ with $10 x + 1$ in the second equation.
Solve the resulting single-variable equation for $x$, then substitute back to find $y$.
